{{Quote|The Gopso'o have been restless for months—ancestral enemies of the Drovians&hellip; Not a particle of difference between them, you understand, except that they have been at blood feud for, literally, centuries. I have heard the original issue was whether the root word for ''truth'' is in the singular case or the plural, but so many atrocities were committed on both sides that, of course, it barely matters now. The Drovians were the ones who made interstellar contact first, so, of course, they're the dominant tribe, but&hellip;"<br />"They're killing each other over a festering grammatical construction?|[[Ism Oolos]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="PoT" />}}
The '''Nim Drovis Civil War''' was fought between the two major tribes on [[Nim Drovis]], the [[Drovian (tribe)|Drovians]] and the [[Gopso'o]]. The exact origins of the war were lost over time, although some believed it started as a dispute over the grammatical construction of the [[Drovian (language)|Drovian]] word for "truth": one side believed it was singular, and the other plural.
